title: Mixed-use infill in the town core
summary: Rezones two wooded sites in the town core for buildings with shops below and apartments above.

how: Planning staff review the rezoning application.
The Planning Commission reviews the proposal and makes a recommendation.
Residents comment at a Town Council public hearing.
Town Council votes on the rezoning.

pros: Adds apartments in the town core.
Adds ground-floor space for shops and offices.
Places homes closer to downtown and campus than the edge woods.
cons: Removes tree canopy from two woods in the core.
Taller, denser buildings next to existing neighborhoods.
More foot and car traffic on downtown streets.
